title: The Moth and the Flame
subtitle: A Deadly Reunion in Patna
summary: A tranquil visit to Patna turns sinister when detective Byomkesh Bakshi and his companions are drawn into a puzzling case after a chance encounter with the enigmatic Purandar Pandey. As shadows gather and secrets unravel, the familiar comfort of old friends is threatened by the chilling specter of a new mystery. Will Byomkesh's keen mind pierce the darkness before it’s too late?
